elements.refinement: Data represent observations or subject matter; raw Data need not be meaningless.
Curated Data may itself already be valuable and productized.

elements.analogy: Fuel in motion, combustion and dashboard reading
elements.originalCharacterization: Contextualized material; data given purpose and meaning
elements.refinement: Combustion illustrates activity; contextualized dashboard indication better illustrates Information. No compulsory engine internal to Product.
The manual represents knowledge; knowledge can also be tacit and inform Information formation.

elements.originalCharacterization: Active capability to interpret and respond
elements.refinement: Intelligence may be human or artificial, does not automatically imply an AI Product, autonomy or authority to act.

originalEducationalLines: Information is a state of Data (data given meaning and context).
Intelligence is an active capability (ability to process and apply meaning).
Without fuel the driver is stranded; without a driver fuel alone does not accomplish the journey.
refinedTeachingLine: Data represents. Information conveys interpreted meaning. Knowledge supports retained understanding. Intelligence is a capacity to reason, adapt and respond.
notNormativeGuardrails: No mandatory raw Data -> Information -> Knowledge -> Intelligence pipeline
Raw or curated Data may be meaningful and useful
Information reuse is not literal physical fuel consumption
Knowledge is not only an external manual
Intelligence does not automatically authorize consequential action
Being AI-created or AI-powered is not equivalent to AI Product qualification
A teaching analogy cannot decide Productness or Product Family
